#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& input;
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    size_t ptr, length;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& in) : input(in), buffer(1024), ptr(0), length(0) {}

    int readByte() {
        if (length == -1) throw std::runtime_error("EOF reached");
        if (ptr >= length) {
            ptr = 0;
            input.read(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            length = input.gcount();
            if (length <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[ptr++]);
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = readByte();
        while (c <= 32) c = readByte();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = readByte(); }
        int num = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Invalid number");
            num = num * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = readByte();
        } while (c > 32);
        return num * sign;
    }
};

void transform(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        while (j >= bit) {
            j -= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j += bit;
        if (i < j) {
            std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
            std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        double cosVal = cos(angle);
        double sinVal = sin(angle);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double cosCur = 1, sinCur = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < len / 2; k++) {
                double uRe = re[i + k], uIm = im[i + k];
                double vRe = re[i + k + len / 2] * cosCur - im[i + k + len / 2] * sinCur;
                double vIm = re[i + k + len / 2] * sinCur + im[i + k + len / 2] * cosCur;
                re[i + k] = uRe + vRe;
                im[i + k] = uIm + vIm;
                re[i + k + len / 2] = uRe - vRe;
                im[i + k + len / 2] = uIm - vIm;
                double newCos = cosCur * cosVal - sinCur * sinVal;
                sinCur = cosCur * sinVal + sinCur * cosVal;
                cosCur = newCos;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

std::vector<int> multiply(const std::vector<int>& x, const std::vector<int>& y, int mod) {
    int required = x.size() + y.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < required) size <<= 1;

    std::vector<double> xr(size, 0.0), xi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((x[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        xr[i] = static_cast<double>(val & 0x7FFF);
        xi[i] = static_cast<double>(val >> 15);
    }
    transform(xr, xi, false);

    std::vector<double> yr(size, 0.0), yi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < y.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((y[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        yr[i] = static_cast<double>(val & 0x7FFF);
        yi[i] = static_cast<double>(val >> 15);
    }
    transform(yr, yi, false);

    std::vector<double> zr1(size, 0.0), zi1(size, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> zr2(size, 0.0), zi2(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        double a1r = (xr[i] + xr[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (xi[i] - xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (xi[i] + xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (xr[j] - xr[i]) * 0.5;
        double b1r = (yr[i] + yr[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (yi[i] - yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (yi[i] + yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (yr[j] - yr[i]) * 0.5;

        zr1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        zi1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        zr2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        zi2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    transform(zr1, zi1, true);
    transform(zr2, zi2, true);

    std::vector<int> output(required, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(zr1[i]);
        long long bb = llround(zr2[i]);
        long long cc = llround(zi1[i]);
        output[i] = static_cast<int>((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx = in.nextInt();
        if (idx < 10) v[idx] = 1;
    }
    std::vector<int> result = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            result = multiply(result, v, 998244353);
        }
        exponent >>= 1;
        if (exponent > 0) {
            v = multiply(v, v, 998244353);
        }
    }
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        sum = (sum + static_cast<long long>(val) * val) % 998244353;
    }
    std::cout << sum << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
